method: Probability propagation and a finite-state Markov chain; no Monte Carlo

model.counts: Conditionally independent Poisson draws given the true input sequence
model.training: Minimax error over current pairs, with previous true comparison supplied correctly
model.actual_feedback: Transfer that fitted policy unchanged; replace supplied correct answer with receiver's actual previous decoded bit
model.worst_case_scope: Worst current-pair error averaged over specified history distribution; not worst over arbitrary sequences
limitations: No reaction kinetics or molecule trajectory correlations
Only one previous window contributes spillover
No encoder-shape or closed-loop policy optimization; a finite scale grid is evaluated
Results are conditional on selected stored rounded encoders
Specified periodic stress sequence is not exhaustive adversarial analysis

history_counterexample.interpretation: This does not violate the uniform-random-history model; it rejects an arbitrary-history interpretation of its 1% bound.
